{
  "subject": "landscape",
  "main_subject": "a kitesurfer silhouetted against a dramatic sunset",
  "lighting": "backlit sunset, with the sun low on the horizon, creating a strong silhouette and warm glow",
  "color_tone": "warm, dominated by oranges, yellows, and reds in the sky; cool blues and purples in the water and shadows",
  "contrast": "high",
  "issues": [
    "slightly overexposed highlights in the sky",
    "cool color cast in the foreground sand and water shadows"
  ],
  "style_directions": [
    "Enhance the warm sunset tones with a golden hour preset",
    "Add a subtle teal and orange contrast to make the colors pop",
    "Boost the vibrance of the sky while keeping the silhouettes dark and dramatic",
    "Reduce the blue color cast in the shadows to make the scene feel more unified and warm"
  ]
}

picks.reason: This preset is specifically designed for sunsets, enhancing the orange tones and adding a cinematic split-toning effect that perfectly complements the existing golden light.
The cool, teal shadows and soft highlights create a beautiful contrast with the warm sun, while the slight vignette draws focus to the kitesurfer and the horizon.
This preset provides excellent highlight recovery and a 'faded' matte look that softens the harshness of the sun while preserving the rich colors of the sky.
